t: What he said with his finger for someone in pain
a: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ بِتُرْبَةِ أَرْضِنَا بِرِيقَةِ بَعْضِنَا لِيُشْفَى سَقِيمُنَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّنَا
p: Bismi-Llāh, bi-turbati arḍinā, bi-rīqati baʿḍinā, li-yushfā saqīmunā bi-idhni rabbinā
m: In the name of Allah. With the dust of our land, with the saliva of one of us, may our sick one be healed by the permission of our Lord.
